route: /style-board/ (the style board: module testimonials:carousel, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: This repeats the earlier finding, which has not been repaired. Now that the section follows the white/tinted alternation and sits on white, the white quote cards with no shadow (--shadow-card: none) do not show at all: the quotes float on the page, set in from the heading's left edge by card padding that nothing visible explains (at both widths).
findings.reference: The competitor's quote cards are raised panels with a soft drop shadow along the bottom and right edges, so each card stands off the surface behind it.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, give .block--testimonials a soft --shadow-card (e.g. 0 6px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)) so that .testimonial picks it up through box-shadow: var(--shadow-card). That makes the cards show on a white or a tinted surface alike.

findings.issue: This repeats the earlier finding, which has not been repaired. A hard dark 1px rule (patterns.css:233, figcaption border-top) still runs across every card between the quote and the attribution, at both widths.
findings.reference: The competitor's cards separate the quote from the bold name with space only, with no rule.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, set `.block--testimonials .testimonial figcaption { border-top: 0; }` and keep the existing padding-top and gap as the separation.
